given: Sequence mode is active with N frames addressed by timeline index 0..N-1. Frame 10 is a reference frame (its index is in sequenceViewMode.referenceFrameIndices). Frame 30 is a non-reference frame inside the propagation range whose image is frames/img_030.png and which has frames/img_030_coco.json beside it (no .npz, no _seg.txt). Frame 31 is a non-reference frame inside the range with no sidecar carrying any of the seven load-chain suffixes. The user starts propagation from the UI with Skip Labeled checked (checkbox default true, sequence_widget.py:347-348) and Keep Flagged unchecked (default false, sequence_widget.py:334-336), so the engine runs with skipFlagged = !keepFlagged = true (main_window.py:4377). Confidence threshold is 0.99 (propagation_manager.py:94). Enabled export formats are the defaults NPZ + YOLO_DETECTION (settings.py:8-9) and Auto-Save on Navigate is on (settings.py:45).
when: The user clicks Propagate (or presses Ctrl+P, which clicks the same button, main_window.py:4710-4716). Before the worker starts, _start_propagation snapshots the labeled set ONCE by walking every frame index 0..N-1, skipping indices that are reference frames, and adding index i when FileManager.findAnnotationFile(imagePath(i)) returns non-null (main_window.py:4219-4231). SAM 2 is never told about the flag, so the model still runs through every frame in the range for temporal continuity; the guard lives entirely on the UI/commit side.
then: skipLabeledFrames = {30}: frame 10 is excluded because it is a reference (main_window.py:4222-4224) and frame 31 because findAnnotationFile returns null; the app logs 'Skip-labeled: 1 frames will keep existing labels' (main_window.py:4228-4231). Every non-reference, non-dimension-mismatch frame status is reset to PENDING (sequence_view_mode.py:143-159) and the timeline is repainted with frame 10 = 'reference' gold rgb(255,193,7) (main_window.py:4241-4246; timeline_widget.py:32). FRAME 10: the engine emits nothing for it — it `continue`s in SAM2 index space before building any result (propagation_manager.py:744-749 non-streaming, 1074-1076 streaming) — and the UI handler would return early anyway (main_window.py:4475-4481); its status stays REFERENCE and it never loads propagated masks when visited (main_window.py:3592-3606). FRAME 30: the engine still creates a PropagationResult per object, appends it to state.frameResults[30] and adds 30 to state.propagatedFrames (propagation_manager.py:783-805; streaming 1110-1125); the UI handler sees 30 in skipLabeledFrames, paints the timeline cell 'skipped' = rgb(139,69,19) brown with immediate repaint, and returns BEFORE the buffer (main_window.py:4466-4473) — so viewMasks[30] stays empty, no confidence is recorded, and the stored model status stays PENDING because markFramePropagated / recordSkippedObject never run (sequence_view_mode.py:290-345). FRAME 31: two objects return at 0.997 and 0.995, both >= 0.99, so nothing is flagged; they accumulate in the per-frame buffer and commit via markFramePropagated(31, {1: mask, 2: mask}, min = 0.995) when the next non-skipped frame arrives or at propagation end (main_window.py:4483-4535, 4537-4574, 4596-4602), giving status PROPAGATED = green rgb(76,175,80). Clicking Save All then takes propagatedFrames {30, 31} minus flaggedFrames {} = [30, 31], announces 'Saving 2 frames...' (main_window.py:4761), `continue`s on frame 30 because getPropagatedMasks(30) is empty (main_window.py:4766-4768), writes only frames/img_031.npz and frames/img_031.txt, and reports 'Saved 1 frames to NPZ' (main_window.py:4846). frames/img_030_coco.json is byte-identical afterwards and no frames/img_030.npz or frames/img_030.txt is created.
and: The no-overwrite guarantee rests on TWO independent stores and a rewrite must gate the SAVE path, not only the paint path. The propagation engine keeps skip-labeled frame 30's masks in state.frameResults[30] and counts 30 in state.propagatedFrames (propagation_manager.py:793-805, 1119-1125), so the 'Propagation complete: N frames' message (main_window.py:4622-4634), the 'Saving N frames...' message (main_window.py:4761) and the post-save 'remaining' count (main_window.py:4843-4844) all over-count by the number of skipped frames. Frame 30 survives Save All only because the view-model store has no masks for it (main_window.py:4766-4768). The dormant PropagationSaveWorker reads the engine's own store (propagation_worker.py:295-370) and is never instantiated anywhere in the codebase; reviving that path would bypass this rule while every engine-level unit test still passed. Separately, the reference-frame half is an unconditional invariant enforced at four points (propagation_manager.py:744-749 and 1074-1076, main_window.py:4222-4224, 4475-4481, 3592-3606), whereas the skip-labeled half is a user-toggleable opt-out; only the first half must hold unconditionally in the rewrite.
parameters: skipLabeled: UI checkbox default TRUE (sequence_widget.py:347-348), read at sequence_widget.py:646-647 and carried through main_window.py:4096 -> 4181 -> 4200 -> 4219; every engine/function-level default is FALSE (main_window.py:4017, 4181 `params.get("skip_labeled", False)`, 4200), and the checkbox state is NOT persisted to settings (no occurrence of skip_labeled outside main_window.py, sequence_widget.py and propagation_manager.py). keepFlagged: default FALSE (sequence_widget.py:334-336); engine receives skipFlagged = !keepFlagged (main_window.py:4377). confidenceThreshold: 0.99 (propagation_manager.py:94). 'Already labeled' = os.path.exists(splitext(imagePath)[0] + suffix) for the first hit in FileManager._LOAD_CHAIN, in this exact order: '.npz', '_seg.txt', '_coco.json', '_CM.npz', '.xml', '_createml.json', '.txt' (file_manager.py:128-136, 138-151). Same directory, same basename stem, existence only — the file is never opened, parsed or size-checked. Timeline colors: 'skipped' rgb(139,69,19), 'reference' rgb(255,193,7), 'propagated' rgb(76,175,80), 'pending' rgb(100,100,100), 'flagged' rgb(244,67,54), 'saved' rgb(0,188,212) (timeline_widget.py:31-40). Frame model statuses: PENDING/REFERENCE/PROPAGATED/FLAGGED/SAVED/SKIPPED/SUGGESTED (sequence_view_mode.py:20-30). Export formats default ['NPZ','YOLO_DETECTION'] (settings.py:8-9); autoSave default true (settings.py:45).
edgeCases: The labeled set is a snapshot taken once in _start_propagation before the worker runs (main_window.py:4219-4231). A sidecar created during the run is not protected; a sidecar deleted during the run still causes the frame to be skipped.

Existence only — no parsing. A stray, empty, corrupt or unrelated <stem>.txt or <stem>.xml makes the frame count as labeled and suppresses propagation for it (file_manager.py:146-151). Conversely an annotation stored under any other name is invisible and the frame is propagated over.

Brown is not guaranteed. The timeline cell is painted 'skipped' only if the engine yields at least one result for that frame. If every object's mask is empty the engine drops it before yielding (propagation_manager.py:756-761, 1092-1093), frameDone never fires, and the frame keeps the gray 'pending' it was reset to at main_window.py:4243 — the labels are still preserved.

Brown is only a view state. The model status stays PENDING (sequence_view_mode.py:196-203), so any batch refresh from the model repaints the cell gray (main_window.py:3470-3472). Brown is also overloaded: dimension-mismatch frames use the same color but DO store FrameStatus.SKIPPED (sequence_view_mode.py:119-121, 590-596) and are exempt from the PENDING reset (sequence_view_mode.py:152-158).

Ordering: the skip-labeled check runs BEFORE the previous frame's buffer is committed and before _propagationPrevFrame is advanced (main_window.py:4466-4487). A skipped or reference frame therefore does not flush the prior frame's buffer; that frame commits on the next non-skipped frame or at propagation end (main_window.py:4596-4602). A rewrite that flushes on every frameDone changes timeline update ordering.

'Frame 31 gets masks' is conditional. With Keep Flagged off (default), a single object below 0.99 sets any_failed and discards ALL of frame 31's masks; only the min confidence is recorded and the frame goes FLAGGED red (main_window.py:4553-4569; propagation_manager.py:764-776). Save All also excludes engine-flagged frames outright (main_window.py:4749-4756).

Propagation itself never writes to disk for any frame, with the flag on or off. Asserting 'img_030_coco.json untouched' immediately after propagation passes even if the guard is deleted. The guard only becomes observable at Save All (main_window.py:4741-4846) and at auto-save on navigate (main_window.py:3424-3427, 3480-3519).

With Skip Labeled OFF, writes go to the ENABLED export formats only (save_export_manager.py:117-122). With the defaults that is <stem>.npz and <stem>.txt, so an existing <stem>_coco.json is not rewritten but is permanently shadowed — .npz is first in the load chain (file_manager.py:128-136) — while an existing <stem>.txt is truly overwritten. An existing <stem>.xml is overwritten only if Pascal VOC is an enabled format.

Deletion path: if the frame's segment list ends up empty, save_single_view_output calls _delete_associated_files -> delete_all_outputs, which removes EVERY registered format's sidecar for that image, not just the enabled ones (save_export_manager.py:106-109, 523-530; exporters/__init__.py:209-215). This is the only code path that deletes user annotation files and it can fire from auto-save on navigate.

Save All is not undoable: mark_frame_saved sets SAVED and deletes the frame's in-memory masks (sequence_view_mode.py:365-373), and undo history is frame-scoped and cleared on navigation (main_window.py:3588-3589).

The Skip Labeled tooltip says it protects 'saved annotations (NPZ files)' (sequence_widget.py:349-353) while the executable check covers all seven formats. The code is authoritative; following the tooltip reintroduces the data-loss bug recorded in CHANGELOG.md:20 and guarded by tests/unit/core/exporters/test_bbox_roundtrip.py:816-839.

Reference frames are excluded from the skip set (main_window.py:4222-4224) so their own annotations are protected by the reference guards, not by Skip Labeled — turning Skip Labeled off does not expose them.
Frames outside the propagation range are never reached, so they are neither painted nor propagated regardless of the flag.
answer: The open question is whether a bare sibling <stem>.txt (or any other same-stem file that is not really an annotation) should count as 'already labeled'. Answer: yes — keep the legacy behavior exactly. findAnnotationFile is a pure existence probe over the seven _LOAD_CHAIN suffixes in priority order and never opens the file (file_manager.py:128-136, 146-151), so a stray notes file suppresses propagation for that frame. Under the approved decisions this is the correct failure direction: a false 'labeled' only declines to propagate (non-destructive and user-visible as a brown cell), whereas a false 'unlabeled' leads to a bulk write that shadows or overwrites hand-made ground truth, and 'match legacy output within tolerance' forbids narrowing the set. What the card got wrong: (1) 'Frame 31 gets propagated masks' is unconditional — in fact with Keep Flagged off (default) a single object below the 0.99 threshold discards ALL of that frame's masks and flags it red (main_window.py:4553-4569; propagation_manager.py:764-776), and masks only land when the buffer is committed on the next non-skipped frame or at finish (main_window.py:4483-4487, 4596-4602). (2) 'Frame 30 is painted skipped (brown)' is unconditional — the paint only happens if the engine yields at least one non-empty result for that frame; all-empty masks are dropped before the yield (propagation_manager.py:756-761, 1092-1093) and the cell stays gray. (3) The card claims no masks exist for frame 30, but that is only true of the view-model store: the engine keeps them in state.frameResults[30] and counts 30 in state.propagatedFrames (propagation_manager.py:793-805, 1119-1125), which is why the 'Saving N frames...' and remaining counts over-count (main_window.py:4761, 4843-4844) and why the guarantee must gate the save path (main_window.py:4766-4768), not just the paint path. (4) 'Skip Labeled default True' is a UI-only default; every Python-level default is False (main_window.py:4017, 4181, 4200) and the checkbox is not persisted, so a service layer that copies the signature inherits the unsafe default. (5) The card's edge case 'propagated masks overwrite those files' is imprecise — writes only touch the enabled export formats (save_export_manager.py:117-122), default NPZ + YOLO Detection, so a _coco.json is shadowed by a new .npz rather than rewritten (file_manager.py:128-136); and the card omits the genuinely destructive path, where an empty segment set makes save_single_view_output call delete_all_outputs and remove every format's sidecar (save_export_manager.py:106-109; exporters/__init__.py:209-215). (6) The card omitted that the stored status staying 'pending' has one exception: a dimension-mismatch frame keeps FrameStatus.SKIPPED through the reset (sequence_view_mode.py:152-158), and that brown is overloaded between the two. An implementer must watch three things: gate the save path on the view store rather than the engine's propagatedFrames; do not flush the previous frame's buffer when a skipped or reference frame arrives (main_window.py:4466-4487); and never resurrect a save path that reads the engine's frameResults directly, the shape of the dormant PropagationSaveWorker (propagation_worker.py:295-370), which would silently defeat this rule.
corrections: Rewrote Given to pin the real preconditions: UI-started run, Keep Flagged off, threshold 0.99, default export formats NPZ + YOLO Detection, auto-save on, and frame 30 labeled via _coco.json rather than an unspecified format.
Rewrote When to state that the labeled set is a one-time snapshot taken before the worker starts, and that SAM 2 still processes every frame (the flag is UI-side only).
Made Then a full worked example with concrete indices, confidences (0.997/0.995), file names, RGB values and the exact notification strings ('Saving 2 frames...', 'Saved 1 frames to NPZ').
Added the precondition to 'frame 31 gets masks': every object must clear 0.99, else with Keep Flagged off all masks for the frame are discarded and it is flagged red.
Qualified the brown paint: it only occurs if the engine yields at least one non-empty result; all-empty frames stay gray/pending.
Added the And clause documenting the two-store double gate, the over-counted progress/remaining messages, and the dormant PropagationSaveWorker that would bypass the rule.

Corrected Parameters: recorded BOTH defaults (UI true, engine false at main_window.py:4017/4181/4200), noted the setting is not persisted, and added threshold, keep-flagged, export-format and auto-save defaults plus the exact status colors.
Kept the seven-suffix list but made it explicit that the check is existence-only, same directory, same stem, in priority order, with no parsing.
Replaced the vague 'propagated masks overwrite those files' edge case with the precise write semantics (enabled formats only; .npz shadows _coco.json; .txt genuinely overwritten).
Added the delete_all_outputs edge case — the only path that deletes user annotation files, reachable from auto-save when a frame ends up with zero segments.
Added the ordering edge case: the skip check precedes the buffer commit, so skipped/reference frames do not flush the prior frame's buffer.
Added the SKIPPED-status exception and the brown-color overloading with dimension-mismatch frames.
Added that propagation writes nothing to disk, so a post-propagation 'file untouched' assertion is vacuous — the contract test must assert at Save All and at auto-save.
Added that reference frames are excluded from the skip set and protected by four independent guards, so turning Skip Labeled off does not expose them.
Noted Save All is irreversible (masks dropped on mark_frame_saved, undo history cleared on navigation).
unresolved: Two product calls remain. (a) The rule as written protects a frame whose only sidecar is a stray, empty or corrupt same-stem .txt/.xml; legacy parity says keep it, but the product owner may want a later, separately-versioned option to validate content before counting a file as 'labeled' — that would be a deliberate divergence from legacy output, not a bug fix. (b) The Skip Labeled tooltip (sequence_widget.py:349-353) understates the rule as 'NPZ files'; whether the rewrite ships the corrected wording ('any supported annotation file') is a copy decision. Both are cosmetic relative to the contract; neither blocks the equivalence test.
